messages:
Nora Lim: Hi all  first day! Nora joining infra. Quick intro: previously on platform at a payments company. Two quick setup things: 1) my phone isn't receiving the MFA push after SSO sign-in. 2) the loaner laptop image seems to be missing Docker. Fun fact: I play clarinet in a community band.

Carlos (IT): Welcome Nora :tada:  For MFA, try removing and re-adding the account in Authenticator app, and check spam for SMS fallback. If push fails, use the backup codes People Ops should have sent. Which device are you using for the push?

Nora Lim: Using iPhone 13, iOS 17. Push shows "pending" forever then times out. I have the backup codes but would prefer push.

Marta (People Ops): Hi Nora! I confirmed your backup codes were emailed to your personal address. I can also re-trigger a device reset if IT wants. Badge and laptop are at reception. Lunch buddy is Ravi this week.

Ravi Singh: Hey Nora, welcome :wave:  Im on infra too. Happy to walk through local dev once you have Docker. We usually use `docker-compose` for the monorepo dev image. Also our standup is 9:15 PT.

Carlos (IT): I kicked an MFA reset for your account and cleared pending sessions. Try signing in again and accept the push. For Docker on the loaner, run:

```
sudo /opt/redwood/setup-docker.sh
```

That will install Docker and add your user to the docker group. Post output if anything errors.

Nora Lim: MFA push worked after the reset, thanks Carlos! Ran the setup script and Docker installed fine. Ran `docker-compose up --build` and the dev stack started.

onboarding-bot: Reminder: New hire orientation tomorrow 09:00 PT. Complete security training by 2026-04-02.

Marta (People Ops): Great! Ill add you to #eng-infra and #devex now. See you at orientation and welcome to Redwood! :rocket:
